data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for sharing content to social media and system share UI.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to share text, URLs, and local images to social media apps including Facebook, WhatsApp, Instagram, Twitter, and Telegram. It also supports native system share UI.
use_when: You need to share text, links, or images directly to specific social media applications like WhatsApp or Facebook.
You want to provide a system share dialog for general sharing.
avoid_when: You only need basic, platform-idiomatic system sharing without specific deep social app integrations.
You want a fully maintained, zero-config plugin without extensive native configuration requirements.
strengths: Supports direct sharing to multiple social networks like WhatsApp, Instagram, and Telegram.
weaknesses: Requires manual native configuration for Android and iOS (such as modifying AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist).
Some APIs and features may vary or throw unimplemented errors across platforms (e.g., WhatsApp Business on iOS).
data.setup_notes: Requires adding app IDs and URL schemes in AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist for Facebook, WhatsApp, and Twitter.

alternatives.name: url_launcher
alternatives.why_pick_it: For launching URLs and custom schemes without heavyweight social SDK integrations.

alternatives.name: share_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: A well-maintained official plus plugin for standard system-level sharing.
